title: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in p
question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.

prediction.sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY total DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS ym,
         SUM(p.amount) AS msum
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT m.customer_id,
         m.ym,
         m.msum - LAG(m.msum) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.ym) AS diff
  FROM monthly m
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       d.ym,
       ROUND(d.diff, 2) AS diff
FROM diffs d
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
WHERE d.diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(d.diff) DESC
LIMIT 1

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY total DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS ym,
         SUM(p.amount) AS mtotal
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT m.customer_id,
         m.ym,
         m.mtotal - LAG(m.mtotal) OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.ym) AS diff
  FROM monthly m
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT d.customer_id, d.ym, d.diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.diff DESC) AS rn
  FROM diffs d
  WHERE d.diff IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       r.ym,
       ROUND(r.diff, 2) AS diff
FROM ranked r
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.diff DESC;
